sections.label: The Models
paragraphs: Kimi K3 on max effort against GPT-6 Astra on low effort. Game 3 of ten, drafted fresh.

Astra mulliganed to six, fell to 7 life by turn 13, and never went lower. Kimi held 20 life until turn 12 and then lost from there in three turns — the cleanest example in the series of a board that looks winning right up until it isn't.

sections.label: Draft
paragraphs: Picks and reasoning are [[view:draft|here]], the final lists [[view:decks|here]].

Kimi drafted Rakdos as essentially mono-black — twelve Swamps to three Mountains — with [[card:Callous Inspector]], [[card:Hog-Monkey]] and [[card:Beetle-Headed Merchants]] as menace threats, [[card:Swampsnare Trap]] and [[card:Day of Black Sun]] as removal.

Astra drafted Selesnya go-wide: [[card:The Earth King]] making Bear tokens, [[card:Suki, Courageous Rescuer]] and [[card:Toph, the Blind Bandit]] as bodies, [[card:Razor Rings]] as instant-speed removal, and [[card:White Lotus Reinforcements]] as the anthem that ends games.

rounds.label: Turn 1
paragraphs: [[player:PilotA|Kimi K3]] takes the play and leads on a Swamp.
[[player:PilotB|Astra]] mulligans an unkeepable one-land seven, keeps a six with three lands and removal, and bottoms [[card:Appa, Loyal Sky Bison]] as too expensive.

rounds.label: Turn 2
paragraphs: [[player:PilotA|Kimi K3]] casts [[card:Callous Inspector]], a 1/1 with menace.
[[player:PilotB|Astra]] plays a Forest and holds its removal.

rounds.label: Turn 3
paragraphs: [[player:PilotA|Kimi K3]] adds [[card:Hog-Monkey]] and attacks for 1 into an empty board.
[[player:PilotB|Astra]] casts [[card:Avatar Enthusiasts]].

rounds.label: Turn 4
paragraphs: [[player:PilotA|Kimi K3]] kills the Enthusiasts with [[card:Swampsnare Trap]] and attacks into the empty board again. Astra is on 15 and has missed its fourth land.
[[player:PilotB|Astra]] casts [[card:Suki, Courageous Rescuer]], a 2/4, purely to stop the bleeding.

rounds.label: Turn 5
paragraphs: [[player:PilotA|Kimi K3]] exhausts [[card:Hog-Monkey]] into a 5/4 with menace and attacks with both menace creatures. A lone 2/4 cannot block either of them, and Astra drops to 9.
[[player:PilotB|Astra]] casts [[card:The Earth King]], which brings a Bear token — 4/4 with Suki's buff — and holds all three creatures home.

rounds.label: Turn 6
paragraphs: [[player:PilotA|Kimi K3]] casts [[card:Day of Black Sun]] for X=0, which kills the 4/4 Bear and spares its own creatures, then attacks. Astra double-blocks the Hog-Monkey with Suki and the Earth King, trading its anthem creature for Kimi's best one, and takes 1 from the Inspector.
[[player:PilotB|Astra]] casts a second [[card:The Earth King]], keeps the untapped original under the legend rule, and banks another Bear.

rounds.label: Turn 7
paragraphs: [[player:PilotA|Kimi K3]] attacks with two menace Inspectors; one trades into the Earth King and Bear double-block, the other connects. Astra is on 7.

[[player:PilotB|Astra]] casts [[card:Toph, the Blind Bandit]], animates a Forest, and starts attacking back — each Bear attack also ramping a land off the Earth King's trigger. Kimi is on 19 and about to stop being comfortable.

rounds.label: Turn 8
paragraphs: [[player:PilotA|Kimi K3]] deploys [[card:Beetle-Headed Merchants]] as a 5/4 but declines to attack into two untapped blockers.
[[player:PilotB|Astra]] casts [[card:Suki, Kyoshi Warrior]] and attacks with the Bear, ramping again. Kimi chump-blocks and falls to 13, then 12.

rounds.label: Turn 9
paragraphs: [[player:PilotA|Kimi K3]] sacrifices [[card:Barrels of Blasting Jelly]] to kill Suki and attacks with the 5/4 Merchants — and Astra kills it with [[card:Razor Rings]] in response to its attack trigger, gaining a life back to 7. Kimi is left on 12 with an empty board.

[[player:PilotB|Astra]] casts [[card:White Lotus Reinforcements]] precombat, which pushes the team over the line, and attacks with the Earth King, a Bear, an animated Forest and Toph for exactly 12. Kimi dies on turn 18.

Kimi was ahead on damage for eight turns and never took a point until turn 13. What it never had was a way to handle a board that rebuilds itself: every Bear attack ramped Astra a land, the Earth Kings kept making more, and the one turn Kimi committed a real threat, [[card:Razor Rings]] answered it at instant speed for a card and a life.
